events.title: Discord Platform Launch & Discord Staff Badge Established
events.description: Discord launched publicly. Internal staff members and founders receive the Discord Staff employee badge (Flag 1<<0).

events.title: Discord Partner Program Introduced
events.description: Discord launched the Partner Program to reward vibrant communities and content creators with custom VIP voice servers, partner hoodies, and the Partner profile badge (Flag 1<<1).

events.title: Discord Nitro Subscription Launched
events.description: Discord introduced the Nitro subscription ($4.99/mo at launch) with custom emoji everywhere, screen sharing, and the Discord Nitro subscriber badge.

events.title: HypeSquad Events Coordinator Badge Formalized
events.description: Discord split the HypeSquad program to establish the HypeSquad Events tier (Flag 1<<2) for offline convention and tournament organizers.

events.title: HypeSquad Houses & Personality Quiz Rollout
events.description: Discord launched the in-app HypeSquad personality aptitude test, dividing millions of community members into Bravery (Flag 1<<6), Brilliance (Flag 1<<7), and Balance (Flag 1<<8).

events.title: Discord Nitro Tiers Split & Early Supporter Cutoff
events.description: Discord introduced Nitro ($9.99/mo) and Nitro Classic ($4.99/mo). Accounts with an active subscription before 7:20 PM PDT permanently received the Early Supporter badge (Flag 1<<9).

events.title: King of the Hat Collaboration Badge
events.description: A temporary crown-adorned HypeSquad Balance badge was awarded during the launch of King of the Hat on Discord Store.

events.title: Server Boosting & Progressive Evolving Streak Badges Introduced
events.description: Discord unveiled Server Boosting along with the 9-tier evolving streak badge family on user profile cards.

events.title: Snowsgiving 2019 Golden Animated Balance Badge
events.description: House of Balance won the charity competition. For approximately 7 weeks (until Feb 3, 2020), Balance badges were rendered in glistening animated gold.

events.title: Bot Verification Program & Developer Badge Introduced
events.description: Discord launched formal bot identity verification at 75+ servers, introducing the Verified Bot Developer badge.

events.title: Verified Bot Developer Converted to 'Early Verified Bot Developer'
events.description: Applications for developer profile badges ceased; the badge was renamed to 'Early Verified Bot Developer' and permanently retired for new developers.

events.title: Discord Certified Moderator Exam & Program Launched
events.description: Discord launched the Moderator Academy and Certified Moderator badge (Flag 1<<18) for qualified community moderators.

events.title: Application Commands (Slash Commands) Badge
events.description: Discord launched the 'Supports Commands' badge for bots adopting modern slash command APIs (Application Flag 1<<19).

events.title: Discord Partner Badge Modern Vector Redesign
events.description: Replaced the legacy circular shield artwork with modern geometric vector partner insignia.

events.title: Discord Nitro Basic Introduced
events.description: Nitro Basic was rolled out at $2.99/mo, introducing a discrete badge icon.

events.title: Active Developer Badge Introduced
events.description: Discord unveiled the Active Developer badge (Flag 1<<22) to recognize developers with active global command traffic in the past 30 days.

events.title: Moderator Programs Restructure & Alumni Rebrand
events.description: The Certified Moderator exam concluded; the badge was rebranded to 'Moderator Programs Alumni' and retired for new applicants.

events.title: New Username System & Legacy Discriminator Badge
events.description: Discord transitioned from Username#1234 to unique @handles, introducing the interactive 'Originally known as' badge for legacy users.

events.title: Discord Partner Program Applications Paused
events.description: Discord temporarily suspended partner applications for system redesign, making Partner badges conditionally obtainable only via server ownership transfer.

events.title: April Fools 2024 Lootbox Simulation Event
events.description: Discord launched the Lootbox simulator event; users who unlocked all 9 parody cosmetics received the permanent Lootbox badge.

events.title: Profile Badges 101 Progression Families Experiment
events.description: Discord began A/B testing progressive 10-tier badge families for Account Age, Game Time, Game Variety, and Live Streaming.

events.title: Bot Tags Renamed to 'APP'
events.description: Discord rebranded user interface flair from 'BOT' to 'APP' across all verified and unverified applications.

events.title: Discord Shop Gifting Milestone Badges
events.description: Introduced the 6-tier Gifting badge progression (Patron to Legend) rewarding users who send Shop gifts and Wishlist purchases.

events.title: Discord Nitro Subscriber & Tenure Milestones Overhaul
events.description: Discord overhauled Nitro subscriber artwork and launched the refined 8-tier gemstone tenure progression up to Opal (6+ years).
